mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ultary_token ( owner_type, user_no, admin_no, connect_ip, connect_agent, refresh_token, expires_at, is_revoked ) VALUES ( #{ownerType}, #{userNo}, #{adminNo}, #{connectIp}, #{connectAgent}, #{refreshToken}, #{expiresAt}, 0 )
mapper.select: SELECT token_id, owner_type, user_no, admin_no, connect_ip, connect_agent, refresh_token, expires_at, is_revoked, revoked_at, created_at, updated_at FROM ultary_token WHERE owner_type = 'USER' AND user_no = #{userNo} AND refresh_token = #{refreshToken} AND is_revoked = 0 AND expires_at > NOW() LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE ultary_token SET is_revoked = 1, revoked_at = NOW() WHERE token_id = #{tokenId} AND is_revoked = 0
UPDATE ultary_token SET is_revoked = 1, revoked_at = NOW() WHERE owner_type = 'USER' AND user_no = #{userNo} AND is_revoked = 0
